Background Options
3 - Gifted (Major): You´re known among your kin for your extraordinary might, cunningness, or charm. Increase the total value of a Stat of your choice by 5. Add a title, moniker, or epithet that describe the trait your known for to your name (e.g.: Tharos the Mighty, Illydriel the Fair, etc). You can also increase the total value of a Stat of your choice (including the one you´ve already chosen) by another 5 points.
2 - Exceptional Training (Major): You´ve studied under a renowned mentor, who taught you the secrets of a particular skill. Name your mentor. You gain 2 ranks in any one Skill of your choice (except Spell Lores), or 5 ranks in a Specialty Skill of your choice. Your mentor also left you an item specially tailored to you as a keepsake. This item grants you a +10 Item Modifier to the chosen skill.
1 - Magical Affinity (Minor): A natural talent and specialized studies made you an expert in a particular school of magic. Choose one of your Vocational Spell Lores to become your favorite Spell Lore. You gain a +10 bonus to all Spell Casting and Arcana Rolls concerning your favorite Spell Lore. --> Eldritch Fire
